citations.text: B. Puente-Mejia, J. Arts, S. Klosterhalfen (2026). Supplementary material for publication "Multi-Echelon Inventory Optimization in Supply Chain Networks: Exploring Network Structures and Predictive Modeling". Zenodo.

description: Synthetic multi-echelon inventory optimisation instances with a serial network structure, one workbook per instance, from the supplementary material of a multi-echelon inventory optimisation study (the record holds serial, convergent, divergent and general families, each its own entry). Each workbook's Nodes sheet is read as one instance: a stage is a node, named by its number, with its holding cost, the mean and standard deviation of its demand (non-zero at leaf stages), its service level and its lead time passing through under the sheet's names; the source states no unit for lead time. The Arcs sheet, which says which stage supplies which, is not read: tasks/v1 has no arcs, and graph/v1 would keep the arcs but lose every stage's figures, since keepset's graph parsers read the edge table alone and do not join a node table to it. The Plot sheet holds a picture.
name: Multi-echelon inventory network structures: serial networks
